evals.name: developer-portfolio-ko
evals.prompt: 제 개인 GitHub Pages용 프로필 페이지를 만들어줘. 이름은 김민수, 클라우드 엔지니어, 서울 거주. 경력은 A사(2022-현재, DevOps Engineer), B사(2020-2022, Backend Engineer) 두 곳. 스킬은 AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Python. 프로젝트는 'my-terraform-modules'(GitHub: github.com/minsu/my-terraform-modules, Live: minsu.github.io/my-terraform-modules) 하나만 있어. GitHub과 LinkedIn 링크도 넣어줘. 모바일에서도 잘 보여야 해.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained responsive HTML profile page (mobile/desktop) with a sidebar (avatar/name/title/links), about, experience timeline, skills tags, and a project card with Live + GitHub links, using only the facts provided.
assertions: Responsive viewport meta present (width=device-width)
Mobile breakpoint present (@media max-width:768px or similar)
Keyboard :focus-visible styles present (accessibility)
Sidebar/identity block with name and title present
Experience timeline with the two given companies present
Project card includes both a Live link and a GitHub link
Self-contained: CSS inlined in <style> (no build step)
Well-formed: section & style tags balanced
No fabricated companies, dates, or projects beyond what was given

evals.name: portfolio-refresh-en
evals.prompt: I already have an index.html on my GitHub Pages user site (attached below) — can you refresh it to add a new project 'edge-cache-cli' (GitHub: github.com/jdoe/edge-cache-cli, Live: jdoe.dev/edge-cache-cli) to the Projects section, without changing anything else?
evals.expected_output: The existing profile page HTML with the new project card added to the Projects section, preserving all other existing content, styling, and files (e.g. analytics scripts, CNAME) untouched.
assertions: Existing sections (about, experience, skills) remain unchanged in content
New project card for edge-cache-cli added with both Live and GitHub links
No unrelated analytics/ads/tracking script removed
Self-contained: CSS remains inlined in <style> (no build step introduced)
Well-formed: section & style tags balanced

evals.name: gh-derived-portfolio-ko
evals.prompt: 내 개인 GitHub Pages 프로필 페이지를 만들어줘. GitHub 사용자명은 <user>야. 이름/직함/거주지는 알려줄게. 프로젝트 섹션은 내 GitHub repo들 중에서 알아서 골라서 채워줘. 경력은 내 LinkedIn(URL)을 참고해서 채울 수 있으면 채워줘.
evals.expected_output: A profile page whose project cards are curated from the user's real repos via gh (Pages-enabled repos first, each with a Live + GitHub link pair), with the selection rationale surfaced to the user; experience appears only if verifiably sourced (LinkedIn fetch/search or user-given facts) — never invented.
assertions: Project cards name only real public repos of the given user (gh-verifiable)
Pages-enabled (hasPages) repos are the showcased candidates; each shows a Live + GitHub link pair
Project selection is confirmed with (or stated to) the user, not silently exhaustive
No fabricated experience entries when LinkedIn is unfetchable
Responsive viewport meta + mobile breakpoint present
Self-contained: CSS inlined in <style> (no build step)
